help.title: Make your first move.
help.card.move.title: Move
help.card.move.body: Right-click ground to travel. Your route appears on the minimap.
help.card.attack.title: Attack
help.card.attack.body: Right-click a hostile to approach and attack. Basic attacks use no mana.
help.card.target.title: Target
help.card.target.body: Left-click selects. Tab finds a foe; Backspace clears. S stops your hero.
help.card.abilities.title: Abilities
help.card.abilities.body: Use {skills} or the on-screen buttons. W/E/R unlock as you level. Spend skill points with {upgrade} or the arrows above the hotbar.
help.card.shop.title: Shop
help.card.shop.body: Press P at your base. Spend earned gold on items that suit your class.
help.card.objective.title: Objective
help.card.objective.body: Follow your minions. Clear every tower in one lane, then destroy the enemy base. Let minions take tower fire. If defeated, wait for your respawn.
help.card.field.title: Read the field
help.card.field.body: Your hero has a double ring; allies have squares; enemies have triangles.
help.card.camera.title: Camera
help.card.camera.body: Y toggles hero follow; Space returns to your hero. Wheel zooms; Settings > Camera remembers the distance. Left-click the minimap to scout. Alt + right mouse orbits the 3D view.
help.reopen: Need this guide again? In a match, press {help_key}. Escape opens the game menu.
help.phone.title: YOUR FIRST MATCH
help.phone.card.move.title: Move
help.phone.card.move.body: Drag the left stick. Release to stop.
help.phone.card.attack.title: Attack
help.phone.card.attack.body: Tap the large right button; hold to repeat. No mana needed.
help.phone.card.target.title: Target
help.phone.card.target.body: Drag ATTACK to extend the reticle. Release on a highlighted foe to lock. Drag to X to cancel.
help.phone.card.farm.title: Farm
help.phone.card.farm.body: The small minion and tower buttons target only that category.
help.phone.card.utility.title: Utility
help.phone.card.utility.body: Dash moves in your stick direction; drag it to aim. Haste boosts movement briefly.
help.phone.card.skills.title: Skills
help.phone.card.skills.body: Q/W/E/R surround ATTACK. Tap to use the locked target, or drag to aim.
help.phone.card.grow.title: Grow
help.phone.card.grow.body: Abilities unlock as you level. Tap RANK, then a glowing skill to spend a point.
help.phone.card.win.title: Win
help.phone.card.win.body: Follow your minions, clear all towers in one lane, then destroy the enemy base.
help.phone.card.recover.title: Recover
help.phone.card.recover.body: Return to your base to heal and shop. If defeated, wait to respawn.
help.phone.card.look.title: Look
help.phone.card.look.body: Tap the minimap to scout. Move the stick to follow your hero again.
help.phone.footer: The match continues while menus are open. Stay connected for the next round.
